title: Serverware native response-proof key evidence v1
description: Original role-4 evidence only. Shape conformance does not verify a Nitro document, key possession, authorization, current witness state or any response proof.

attestationDocumentB64.description: Original Nitro document in unpadded URL-safe base64. Runtime verification checks canonical encoding, the 12288-byte decoded bound, signature, independently pinned scope and challenge.

responseProofPublicKey.description: Raw 32-byte Ed25519 public key, not DER, in canonical unpadded URL-safe base64. The separate key ID hashes its Ed25519 SPKI DER; cryptographic verification joins both identities.
